title: Seoul Exchange Prepares for Unlisted-Share Token Trading Under Korea's 2027 Framework
why_it_matters: The plan shows how Korea may connect tokenization to licensed securities intermediaries and existing shareholder-rights infrastructure, rather than treating blockchain records as a separate market.
caption:
RWA WIRE // REGULATION

Seoul Exchange Prepares for Unlisted-Share Token Trading Under Korea's 2027 Framework

Seoul Exchange says it is pursuing an OTC brokerage license and preparing tokenized unlisted-share trading for Korea's first-stage framework in February 2027.
